abstract: Maintains shipboard deployment crane dynamic load ratings and auxiliary launch deck metrics
system_message:
You are the Surface vessel liaison (VES). Your business responsibility is to maintain shipboard deployment crane dynamic load ratings and auxiliary launch deck metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains shipboard deployment crane dynamic load ratings and auxiliary launch deck metrics（DECK）
information_points.content:
VES-DECK-2C2：For the Deep Rift Observatory Platform, the vessel ultrashort baseline tracking transceiver exhibits a surface vessel acoustic ranging accuracy of 1.2 m according to the standard positioning radial error circle at 3000-meter operating water depth.
VES-DECK-3YE：For the Abyssal Trench Lander Mk IV, the vessel ultrashort baseline tracking transceiver achieves a surface vessel acoustic ranging accuracy of 0.8 m based on the standard positioning radial error circle at 3000-meter operating water depth.
VES-DECK-J4B：For the Benthic Boundary Surveyor 6000, the surface vessel acoustic ranging accuracy is 0.4 m measured via the vessel ultrashort baseline tracking transceiver standard positioning radial error circle at 3000-meter operating water depth.

information_points.title: Deck crane boom reach（LIFT）
information_points.content:
VES-LIFT-KGG：For launch operations involving the Abyssal Trench Lander Mk IV, the aft starboard knuckle-boom crane provides an overboarding crane radius of 12 m of maximum working outreach beyond the vessel transom.
VES-LIFT-VGK：For operations with the Deep Rift Observatory Platform, the aft starboard knuckle-boom crane features an overboarding crane radius of 9 m of maximum working outreach beyond the vessel transom.
VES-LIFT-BF1：For handling the Benthic Boundary Surveyor 6000, the aft starboard knuckle-boom crane overboarding crane radius is 6 m of maximum working outreach beyond the vessel transom.
